# Macquarie University Researchers Portal

> A comprehensive research portal and researcher directory for Macquarie University, providing access to research outcomes, collaborations, and institutional research frameworks with full accessibility compliance.

This portal serves as the central hub for Macquarie University's research community, enabling researchers to showcase their work, collaborate across disciplines, and maintain compliance with web accessibility standards. The site prioritizes inclusive access through WCAG 2.1 AA compliance and support for assistive technologies.

## Key Topics

- Macquarie University
- Research Portal
- Researcher Directory
- Research Outcomes
- Research Collaborations
- Research Framework
- WCAG 2.1 AA Compliance
- Web Accessibility
- Assistive Technologies (JAWS, NVDA, VoiceOver)
- Disability Support
- Accessibility Regulations
- Accessibility Statement
- Compliance Reporting
- University Research

## Core Research Portal

- [Macquarie University Researchers Portal](https://researchers.mq.edu.au): Main research portal and researcher directory for Macquarie University, providing access to research outcomes, collaborations, and institutional research frameworks

## Accessibility & Compliance

- [Web Accessibility Statement](https://researchers.mq.edu.au/en/web-accessibility): WCAG 2.1 AA compliance statement detailing accessibility features, supported assistive technologies (JAWS, NVDA, VoiceOver), known issues, and contact information for accessibility support
